score_semantics: Source-contract confidence only; not parcel-result or numeric elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model 1m
verified_facts: Approximately 99% of England is covered at 1m resolution
DSM includes vehicles, buildings, vegetation and terrain
GeoTIFF tiles are aligned to the OS National Grid
Heights are in metres relative to Ordnance Datum Newlyn using OSTN15
Input surveys report +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy
semantic_limits: DSM must never replace the primary DTM result
Composite surveys span different dates and must use survey-index metadata

candidates.name: Coordinate transformations
verified_facts: GNSS positioning uses ETRS89
OS mapping uses OSGB36 British National Grid
OS heights use mean-sea-level datums such as Ordnance Datum Newlyn
OSTN15 and OSGM15 link GNSS positions to national horizontal and vertical systems
semantic_limits: A transformed coordinate is not a parcel identity proof
The exact polygon must be sampled in one controlled coordinate system
WGS84 ellipsoidal height must not be treated as ODN terrain height

candidates.name: Accuracy of OS Net, OSTN15 and OSGM15
verified_facts: OS Net station standard errors are generally better than 0.008m plan and 0.020m height
OSTN15 agreement with old triangulation stations is 0.1m RMS
OSGM15 Great Britain height standard error is 0.008m excluding GNSS errors
semantic_limits: Transformation error is only one part of total parcel-result uncertainty
Values do not replace raster vertical accuracy or polygon-edge effects
GNSS errors are excluded from the OSGM15 figure

candidates.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
verified_facts: GLO-30 is a 30m global Digital Surface Model
Surface includes buildings, infrastructure and vegetation
Vertical reference is EGM2008 and unit is metres
Published absolute vertical accuracy is less than 4m at 90% linear error
Published horizontal accuracy is less than 6m at 90% circular error
semantic_limits: Not acceptable for primary parcel-scale measurement
DSM surface-object bias and coarse resolution require strict tertiary-only use

candidates.name: Copernicus DEM 30m view-service licence notice
verified_facts: From 28 July 2026 the GLO-30 view service requires an authorised CCM user category
Users must update their CDSE profile to request CCM access
Unregistered users will lose view-service access
semantic_limits: This is an access contract, not an elevation source
View-service rules do not prove bulk-download eligibility
Copernicus remains a tertiary crosscheck only
